description: This file is a shell script used for managing release version bumps, including analyzing git history, determining version increments, and updating metadata files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and available command-line options.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Prints informational messages to standard output.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the pull request number associated with a git commit.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels associated with a pull request via GitHub API.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component directory from a given file path based on metadata.yaml locations.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks whether a file path is considered documentation-like based on naming or directory patterns.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates the version and generation fields in a metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on current values and bump type.
